about_the_game:
Card Coder merges tactical card battles, inventory management and roguelike deck-building with a novel twist: Create your own custom cards during each run by constructing cybernetically enhanced warriors from all over the galaxy. Defeat challenging enemies to loot, shop and collect many different ability components. Equip your cards with these components to define their behavior according to your playstyle:

Build up your engine and cause powerful chain-reactions across the board. Use everything to your advantage and crush your enemies in this challenging rogue-like run and get a taste for the full game in this demo.

Demo Features

  • Beat the first 5 levels of the roguelike-campaign in this demo version of Card Coder.

  • Play as the powerful Panda Blaster Commander - the full version allows you to choose between three Commanders.

  • Beyond deckbuilding: Create your own cards as you play by combining triggers, conditions, selectors and effects! Build your cards to fit your playstyle -- not the other way round!

  • Tactical, grid-less combat: Manipulate enemy cards' targeting aggro by placing your cards freely on the board. Take advantage of superior positioning.

  • Cosmetic card customization: The card-building aspect of Card Coder does not stop at scripting the mechanics. To make cards memorable and easy to distinguish in battle you can also customize the visuals of each card: Change the title, adjust the color tint, select awesome artwork from different pixel artists or even replace the card's artwork with any custom image you choose.

  • Upgrade the rarity of ability components by merging duplicates to gain stats bonuses and powerful status auras.

  • Save Anytime: Need to leave in the middle of a run? No problem. Card Coder saves the game exactly where you are, so you can pick up where you left off at any time.

Try the DEMO now and add Card Coder to your Wishlist.

  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Core i5 8400, Ryzen 5 2600

  • Graphics: GTX 1070
